title: PR 2a — ledger writer extraction + tax-aware repost

goals.text: lib/ledger-writer exports appendBalancedEntry (refuses unbalanced entries; P2002 with an identical payload returns the existing entry, a different payload throws LedgerKeyConflict code P2002) and assertPeriodOpen (closed-period gate, month derived in UTC); the expense ledger posts through it with no behaviour change for untyped 2-line, 3-line-with-tax-liability and split entries.

A tax-typed expense booked DR category(net+nonrecoverable) | DR 2100(recoverable) | CR 1000(gross) can have its amount edited, category changed or cleared, be deleted, and be reclassified out of 6999 suspense; each leaves every entry balanced and the P&L at the exact net figure.

launch.rollback: Revert the PR. No schema change and nothing writes a 3-line typed entry yet, so the ledger holds no rows that depend on the new code; the expense ledger returns to its module-private writer.
